handoffs.message: EVO-001 EvolutionDecision service implementation complete. Commit 5535c426. Service at services/evolution/ is fully implemented: 16 HTTP routes covering proposal lifecycle (proposed→reviewed→approved→executed/rejected/canceled), actor-role gates, evidence enforcement, cooldown/observation windows, single-active rule, incident-derived proposals, boundary/action-path endpoints, threshold evaluation, and rollback/redeploy follow-through. Evidence packet: support/evidence/EVO-001/README.md. Verification: python3 -m pytest services/evolution/test_evolution_service.py -q → 57 passed. Sidecar acceptance packet approved. BFF v5 read-model integration (loop-runs, sentinel/findings) is out of scope for this task — separate Sprint 6 tasks.
Codex review approved; no blocking findings. Owner Claude should run closeout and finalize to done.
